seo.title: About Us
seo.description: Learn about Proprio Alliance — Montreal's trusted partner in property management. Discover our mission, values, and experienced team.

intro.headline: The Experts In Property
paragraphs: At Proprio Alliance, we believe property management should be simple, transparent, and worry-free. Born out of a passion for real estate and a commitment to excellence, our company was founded by experienced professionals who saw an opportunity to do things better—for property owners, tenants, and communities alike.

After years of working within the industry, we realized that many property owners were looking for more than just maintenance and rent collection—they wanted a team they could trust. That's why we started Proprio Alliance: to offer reliable, personal, and results-driven property management services that give our clients peace of mind.

whatWeDo.headline: What We Do
whatWeDo.description: We specialize in full-service property management, handling everything from tenant placement and rent collection to maintenance, inspections, and 24/7 support. Whether you own a single unit or a growing portfolio, we tailor our services to fit your needs and ensure your property is well-managed, profitable, and cared for.

items.title: Creating Lifelong Partnerships
items.description: Fostering trust and strong relationships for long-term success in real estate.

items.title: Empowering Real Estate Decisions
items.description: Providing expert insights to help you make confident, informed property choices.

items.title: Offering Complete Real Estate Solutions
items.description: With a real estate agent on our team, we offer exclusive listings and expert advice under one roof.

more.headline: More Than Just Management
more.description:
One of the things that sets Proprio Alliance apart is our in-house licensed real estate agent, which allows us to offer a complete and seamless experience. Thanks to this added expertise, we're able to provide:

  • Access to exclusive listings on premium platforms like Centris
  • Professional property marketing for rentals or sales
  • Expert guidance on buying, selling, or optimizing your investments

Whether you're looking to fill a vacancy, grow your portfolio, or sell a property, you'll benefit from an integrated, one-stop solution—no need to juggle multiple service providers.

footerCta.title: Let's Work Together
footerCta.description: At Proprio Alliance, we're more than just property managers—we're your dedicated real estate partners.
